definitions.chi_E: Eperp / Eeddy; Eperp is kinetic energy of departure from y mean, Eeddy excludes horizontal mean.
definitions.chi_q: Zvariance / Za, where a=q-q0; a measure of transverse dependence of q, not all velocity components.
definitions.mean_error: epsilon_U = depth RMS of [Delta UE - Delta UE_2D] / depth RMS of Delta UE_2D at 1200 s. Each Delta subtracts its own initial profile.
definitions.history_error: The whole error(t) history is normalized by the matched 2D final 1200 s changed-profile RMS, not a vanishing early-time amplitude.
definitions.Re_inj: U2D_initial * injection_wavelength / nu; not Taylor-microscale Reynolds number.
definitions.u3D: Initial RMS transverse-dependent velocity, U2D_initial sqrt(eta). No-wave cases have no ratio to actual us=0.
definitions.sampling: All measured source CSV cadences are 1 s in this campaign; maxima are over saved times. Public geometry-history.csv selects every 20 s. mean-error-history.csv retains 1 s. Late averages cover 600–1200 s.
definitions.residuals: Residuals copied from published full-depth quadrature, normalized by max(initial moment, maximum excursion, maximum native integral).

parameter_support.u_star: No imposed wind stress; not a varied control.
